papers.title: Joining of Metal-Plastics-Hybrid Structures Using Laser Radiation by Considering the Surface Structure of the Metal
papers.abstract: Lightweight construction is a central technology in today’s industrial production. One way to achieve the climate goals is the production of hybrid compounds of metal and plastic. The manufacturing process for these hybrid parts can be divided into in-mold assembly and postmold assembly. The postmold assembly includes thermal joining by laser, which is applied in the context of this paper. For the investigations, four plastics (MABS, PA6.6-GF35, PP, and PC), which differ in their properties, and three metals (unalloyed steel, stainless steel, and aluminum) are combined and analyzed. These materials have been used, since they have a huge significance in the automotive industry. Preliminary studies showed that an adhesive bond between the two materials is achieved using metal with a structured surface. According to these studies, three structuring processes for metals (selective laser melting (SLM), NRX, and a welded metallic tissue) are tested. The quality of the material/structure combinations is tested in tensile-shear-tests, microscopy images, and alternating climate tests. Compounds with SLM-Structure achieve highest strength, while compounds with aluminum are much more complex to manufacture.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究金属-塑料混合结构的激光连接，不涉及生物医学植入物、多孔结构或应力遮挡。
llm.why_not_core: No porous structure for stress shielding, no LPBF fabrication of biomedical implants, no mechanical testing relevant to osseointegration or fatigue.

summary_zh.motivation: 轻量化制造中金属-塑料混合结构的激光连接工艺研究
summary_zh.method: 使用SLM、NRX和焊接金属网对金属表面进行结构化处理，然后激光连接塑料
summary_zh.result: SLM结构获得最高连接强度，铝材连接更复杂
summary_zh.validation: 拉伸剪切测试、显微镜观察和交变气候测试

summary_en.motivation: To investigate laser-based joining of metal-plastic hybrid structures for lightweight construction in automotive industry.
summary_en.method: Three metal structuring processes (SLM, NRX, welded metallic tissue) were tested for adhesive bonding with four plastics under laser radiation.
summary_en.result: SLM-structured joints achieved the highest tensile-shear strength, while aluminum compounds were more challenging to manufacture.
summary_en.validation: Tensile-shear tests, microscopy, and alternating climate tests were performed to evaluate joint quality.

papers.title: THE EFFECTS OF SCAN STRATEGIES ON SELECTIVE LASER MELTED PARTS
papers.abstract: The utilisation of Additive Manufacturing (AM) for the production of intricate part geometries in the aerospace, medical, and tool-and-die industries is increasingly considered for incorporation in manufacturing process chains. It is important to note that AM also bears certain disadvantages, one of which is geometrical deviations within parts. Warping of parts is ascribed to the presence of high temperature gradients as well as the melting and solidification rates within the two dimensional layers, leading to the induction of residual stress. The Selective Laser Melting (SLM) process is generally characterised by high scan speeds and high thermal gradients which results in high cooling rates of the scanned part. The high cooling rates lead to non-equilibrium microstructures as well as warping of the melted layer. This paper discusses the effects of the thermally induced residual stress on the geometric deviation of titanium parts. Different scan strategies were performed on a single layer of powder and the deviation due to warping was measured using image processing software. The measurements were compared to each other and the best strategies were revealed.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要关注SLM工艺参数对零件几何偏差的影响，未涉及生物医学植入物的力学性能或骨整合特性。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration; it focuses solely on geometric deviations from scan strategies.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究扫描策略对SLM钛合金零件几何偏差的影响
summary_zh.method: 对单层粉末采用不同扫描策略，通过图像处理测量翘曲
summary_zh.result: 比较了不同策略的翘曲偏差，找出了最佳策略
summary_zh.validation: 实验测量单层翘曲并与图像分析对比

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of scan strategies on geometric deviations in SLM titanium parts.
summary_en.method: Different scan strategies were applied to a single powder layer and warping was measured using image processing.
summary_en.result: The best strategies with minimal warping were identified.
summary_en.validation: Experimental measurements of single-layer warping were compared across strategies.
